Question 5
?

The point (a,b) lies on the curve y=|x|. Which of the following points must lie on y=|x+3|−2?

a
(a+3,b−2)
b
(a+3,b+2)
c
(a−2,b−3)
d
(a−3,b−2)
e
(a−3,b+2)
